strapiBlog.title: Lights, Glamour, Action: All About DAMAC Islands Official Launch in Dubai!
strapiBlog.short_description: The excitement was sky-high as DAMAC’s third and largest master community in 2024, DAMAC Islands, was officially launched in Dubai at the famous Coca-Cola Arena.

data.text:
The excitement was sky-high as DAMAC’s third and largest master community in 2024, DAMAC Islands, was officially launched in Dubai at the famous Coca-Cola Arena. Held on Tuesday, 19th November 2024, the event was a spectacular celebration of style, creativity, and bold ideas, showing why the city is a world leader in property investment. From star-studded performances to breathtaking reveals, the night was one to remember. Let’s dive into the highlights of this unforgettable celebration!

Dubai Shines Bright - DAMAC Islands Official Launch

The charismatic Karan Vahi co-hosted the spectacular launch of DAMAC Islands. Special guests, Bollywood icons Ranveer Singh and Sara Ali Khan, captivated the audience with their presence and showcased the magnificence of this development.

The night was further elevated by appearances from global personalities such as British former boxer Amir Khan, English football coach and former player John Terry and his wife Tony Terry, and Lebanese actress and Miss Labenese 2004, Nadine Nassib Njeim.

The event blended elegance, star power, and entertainment, making it an unforgettable celebration. Yet, the true showstopper of the night was the unveiling of the DAMAC Islands model, giving attendees an exclusive first glimpse into this project. 

Dr. Hussain Sajwani, Founder and Chairman of DAMAC shared the visionary concept behind the project, highlighting its seamless blend of island-inspired beauty and urban amenities. Adding to the moment, Managing Director Amira Sajwani delivered an inspiring speech, showcasing her unwavering commitment to elevating Dubai’s real estate landscape.

Our Provident Estate agents were also part of this iconic celebration, witnessing the future of the opulent lifestyle firsthand. With exclusive insights and updates, our team is ready to guide you through everything this groundbreaking development offers. Get in touch with us to uncover exclusive insights about the project.

Register your interest or download the brochure here to learn more about the DAMAC Islands properties. Hurry—units are selling out fast!

data.text:
DAMAC Islands: A Community Redefined

DAMAC Islands, located in the heart of Dubailand, reimagines luxury through an island-inspired theme. DAMAC Islands in Dubailand marks the developer’s sixth master-planned community, drawing inspiration from renowned island destinations around the world. The project will include six distinct clusters: Maldives, Bora Bora, Seychelles, Hawaii, Bali, and Fiji, boasting features such as:

  • Serene lagoons and waterfalls.
  • The exclusive Aqua Dome, a haven for aquatic adventures.
  • A jungle park, hot springs spa, and paddle boat rides for an immersive natural experience.
  • Community spaces like a tortoise garden, wedding venue, and fresh fruit market, all designed to foster a vibrant and inclusive lifestyle.

Luxury Meets Investment Opportunity

The DAMAC Islands launch wasn't just a celebration; it marked the arrival of an exceptional investment opportunity. Offering:

  • Luxury villas starting at AED 6.3M, with spacious 6 to 7-bedroom layouts.
  • Trendy townhouses are available in 4 and 5-bedroom configurations, starting at AED 2.25M.
  • The developer offers a flexible 75/25 payment plan, with 75% payable during construction and the remaining 25% upon completion. This makes it appealing to both end-users and investors.

This development follows DAMAC Properties' legacy of successful projects such as DAMAC Hills and Riverside, setting new benchmarks for Dubai’s luxury real estate market.

From the mesmerizing performances to the captivating speeches and the unveiling of a truly groundbreaking project, the DAMAC Islands Launch Event was nothing short of spectacular. Attendees walked away with more than memories—they witnessed the future of luxury living.

As DAMAC continues to redefine urban opulence, DAMAC Islands promises to be the pinnacle of island-inspired living, blending serenity, community, and world-class amenities in one iconic location.

Stay tuned for updates on this groundbreaking development, and don’t miss your chance to be part of Dubai’s most luxurious island community!
